text:
Comment “director” and I’ll send you the link to try it.
I turned one photo into a five-minute cinematic thriller just by talking to AI.
OpenArt Director built the characters, scenes, lighting, sound, and story, then let me reshape everything through conversation.
This isn’t prompting anymore. It’s directing.

#aitools #aivideo #openart #aifilmmaking #aiforcreators

text:
Want that soft, expensive-looking “Hollywood” light?

Try a book light.

Instead of pointing your key directly at your subject:

Bounce the light into a large white surface → send that bounced light through diffusion → angle the diffusion toward your subject.

Now you’ve taken a small, hard source and turned it into a much larger, softer source that wraps around the face beautifully.

Softer shadows. Smoother highlights. Better skin.

It takes up more space, but when I want that really soft, polished interview look, this is one of my favorite setups.

topComments.text: Hello can i use a 5 in 1 diffuser for this?

text:
Diffusion doesn’t automatically mean soft light.

If your light is right up against the diffusion, you may only be illuminating a small portion of it. That means your effective light source is still small, which can leave you with harder shadows.

Back the light away from the diffusion and let it spread across more of that surface.

Now you’ve created a much larger source.

Bigger source = softer shadows, smoother transitions, and much more flattering light.

So don’t just throw a scrim in front of your light.

Fill the scrim.

#contentcreator #contentcreationtips #filmmakingtips #cinematiclighting #productionlife

text:
Filming outside can’t be cinematic…”

Yeah, it can. You just have to stop letting the sun do whatever it wants. 😂

A scrim softens that harsh overhead sunlight.
A black flag subtracts light and brings shape back into the face.

Now instead of flat, uncontrolled daylight, you’re actually shaping the light.

That’s the difference.

You don’t always need more lights. Sometimes you just need to diffuse, subtract, and control what’s already there.

Flags and scrims are ridiculously underrated.

#contentcreator #contentcreationtips #productionlife #filmmakingtips #cinematiclighting

text:
Lighting isn’t just about adding more light.

In this setup I’m using:
negative fill to deepen the shadows,
a bounce fill to gently bring some of them back,
and chin fill to clean up the shadows under the face.

That’s the part people miss.

Good lighting isn’t about making everything bright. It’s about deciding where you want the shadows, how deep you want them, and where you want detail back.

Learn to control your shadows, and your lighting gets way better.
#contentcreator #contentcreationtips #productionlife #filmmakingtips #cinematiclighting

text:
The farther the key, the harsher the shadows.
The closer the key, the softer the shadows.

And the reason is simple:

When you move the same light closer to your face, it becomes larger relative to you.

Larger apparent source = softer light.

That means softer shadow edges, smoother transitions across the face, and generally a more flattering look.

Move that same light farther away and it becomes smaller relative to you, so the shadows get harder and more defined.

This is why I’m constantly telling people to stop putting their key light across the room and cranking it to 100%.

Bring it in close. Keep it just out of frame. Turn it down.

Your lighting will immediately look better.

text:
Comment “Luma” and I’ll DM you the link.
I built one cinematic campaign, then turned the creative process behind it into a reusable workflow inside Luma.
That’s the real shift happening in AI creation.
One-off generations get attention. Repeatable creative systems let you build, improve, and scale an idea without starting from zero every time.
The future won’t belong to the creator using the most tools.
It’ll belong to the creator with the strongest process.
Now you know.

#lumaskills #aifilmmaking #aitools #generativeai #aivideo

text:
Stop using your key light wrong.

One of the biggest mistakes I see is putting the light way across the room and cranking it to 100%.

Now you’ve got harsh shadows, hot spots, and blown-out highlights all over your face.

Instead, bring that light CLOSE. Like close enough that you could reach out and touch it, but just outside the frame.

Then turn the output way down. I’m usually somewhere around 20–30% depending on the light.

Why?

The closer the light is, the larger it becomes relative to your face.

Larger source = softer light.

Softer shadows. Smoother highlights. Better-looking skin.

Stop trying to light your face from across the room. 😂

#contentcreationtips #filmmakingtips #cinematiclighting #contentcreator #productionlife

text:
Never buy another softbox until you try this. 😂

$200+ softbox vs. a $10 shower curtain…

And I prefer the shower curtain.

Why? Bigger source = softer light.

By pushing the light through a much larger diffusion surface, I get softer shadows, smoother falloff, and a look I like way more.

Expensive doesn’t always mean better. Sometimes you just need a bigger light source.

text:
Does size really matter? 👀

When it comes to soft light… absolutely.

A small softbox might look “soft,” but firing a light through a large scrim creates a much bigger light source - which means softer shadows, smoother skin, and a more flattering image.

Bigger source = softer light.

Sometimes the upgrade isn’t a more expensive light. It’s making the light you already have bigger.

#productionlife #filmmakingtips #cinematiclighting #cinematicvideo

When it comes to quality of light (soft-hard) these two images are very similar. The difference you see here has nothing to do with it.

The reason they are similar is you are illuminating the scrim with a circle about the same size as your softbox, back up that light to illuminate the scrim even better and you get softer light.

text:
I’m 14 days away from my birthday, and my childhood just showed up in a very large box. 👀📦
I’m turning this room into my dream ’90s game room and this delivery made it feel real. The room’s nowhere near finished, but the kid in me is already losing his mind.
What’s the ONE thing your childhood game room would have to have? 👇
Follow the build to see what’s next and whether I can pull this off by October 1. 🕹️
Thank you to AB Video Arcades for the amazing build! 
www.abvideoarcades.com
#retro #nostalgia #90s #gaming #gameroom

text:
This AI cat sitcom might be the blueprint for the future of AI filmmaking.
Milo & Family proves that audiences don’t build relationships with individual AI generations-they build relationships with characters, stories, and worlds they want to revisit.
The technology gets their attention.
The story makes them stay.
This is where AI filmmaking is heading: recurring series, original worlds, and scalable creative IP.
Dreamina AI

Day 10/30 of The Real Ones.
“Let me know if you need anything” sounds kind until you realize they watched you struggle, gave you no real help, and made asking feel like another burden.
Follow if you are done mistaking nice words for people who actually show up.

text:
20 days until my birthday, and I’ve decided my dream 90s game room needs a secret Blockbuster entrance. 📼
Blockbuster was my first job. Those Friday nights wandering the aisles, reading every cover, and picking out movies still hold a special place in my heart.
So I’m bringing a little of that home - with yellow shelves, real VHS tapes, and one movie that releases the hidden door.
Now I just have to build it… and finish the rest of the room before my birthday. 😅
Which movie should open the door? Tell me in the comments. 👇
Follow along for the build, the first door test, and to see if I finish before my birthday on October 1.
#Blockbuster #90s #nostalgia #GameRoom #DIY

text:
Day 1 of turning the ugliest room in my studio into my dream 80s/90s game room. 🎮📼

The catch? I have 22 days to finish it before my birthday.

Arcades. Pinball. VHS. Retro toys. All of it.

And right now… this room is ROUGH. 😂

I’m taking you through the entire transformation, one day at a time.

22 days. One room. Let’s see if I can actually pull this off.

Follow me now and watch this incredible transformation unfold and comment below to tell me what you think I should add!

#retro #nostalgia #gameroom #diy #transformation

text:
Day 08/30 of The Real Ones.
The person who reminds you of every favor was never trying to help you. They were building a debt they could use the first time you said no.
Follow if you are done confusing guilt with loyalty.

#selflove #relationships #friendship #toxicrelationships #loyalty

text:
Day 07/30 of The Real Ones.
Some people only love you when you are easy to be around. Funny. Available. Fine.
The second you are tired, quiet, or need something back, they act like you changed.
Follow if you are done performing just to keep people comfortable.

#selflove #relationships #friendships #toxicrelationships #selfawareness

text:
Day 06/30 of The Real Ones.
The betrayal is not always the person who said it. Sometimes it is the person who heard it, knew it was a lie, and decided protecting their place in the room mattered more than protecting your name.
Follow if you are done finding out who people are after they have already let you down.

#truefriends #relationships #friendship #loyalty #selflove

text:
Day 05/30 of The Real Ones.
You were not asking them to fix your life. You just wanted them to remember you were having one.
Follow if you are done calling it “a bad memory” when somebody keeps proving you do not matter to them.
#relationships #friendship #lifelesson #selfawareness

text:
The people who cost you the most were the easiest to like. That was never a coincidence.

You can fake charm. You can’t fake being bad at it.

Don’t forget to follow for the rest of the people you need in your life. 

#relationships #friends #selfawareness #contentcreator #lifelesson

My dad has been gone for a long time and he still texts me. 

Everybody has one of these. A song, a number, a bird on the same post every morning. Almost nobody says it out loud.

What’s yours?

It’s the little things in lighting that make the biggest difference. 

If you put your key light too high, it gives you raccoon eyes. If you put your key light just over eye level, that equals perfection. 👌🏻

text:
❗️Comment “DREAMINA” and I’ll send you the link ❗️

I’ve tested basically every AI video model out there, and they all had the same fatal flaw. You never knew what you were going to get. You typed, you hoped, you rerolled it fifty times and prayed.

Seedance 2.5 is the first one that feels like control instead of gambling.
You stop describing and start showing it. Up to 50 references, images, audio, even full video, and it holds your character and your world in every single frame. One detail off? You fix that one thing and never touch the rest. And it runs cheapest on Dreamina, which is where it launched first, ByteDance’s own platform, same parent company as TikTok.
This is the moment AI video stopped being a toy.

Tap the link in my bio to try it for yourself. 

#dreamina #dreaminapartner #seedance #dreaminaseedance25 #aitools

text:
❗️Comment “CLEAN” and I’ll send you the link ❗️

The reason I wasn’t posting enough had nothing to do with ideas. It was the editing.

Every um, every restart, every “let me do that again” turned a two minute video into an hour of cleanup. So I just filmed less.

Then OpusClip quietly turned into a full editor. Now I record messy on purpose, the pauses, the filler, the blown takes, and it finds all of it and cuts it for me. Blurry clip? It sharpens it. Flat clip? One preset styles it. The thing I knew as a clipper edits the whole video now.

I record. It cleans it up. I post. That’s the entire process.

OpusClip 

#aitools #contentcreator #aiediting #contentcreationtips #editing

text:
❗️Comment RUNWAY for the link and 50% off with code MCP50. Or grab it in my bio.❗️

Nobody talks about how much time you lose just jumping between AI tools.

Type the idea in one app. Open Runway. Paste it. Wait. Export. Re-upload somewhere else. Do the whole dance again tomorrow.

I stopped doing that. Runway now lives inside the tools I already work in, so the finished video just shows up in the same chat I’m already typing in. No tabs, no exports, no re-uploading the same file five times.

If you basically live inside Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or Replit, this quietly changes how you make everything.

#aitools #runway #mcp #aivideo #aiforcreators

text:
Where you aim your bounce changes your entire face on camera. Low makes your eyes look puffy. Mid is better but not great. High at eye level is where it clicks. You are not just filling shadows. You are lighting the eyes. That is where the life in your image comes from. Light the eyes not the chin.

Who knew this??

#contentcreator #contentcreationtips #cinematiclighting #filmmakingtips #cinematicvideo

❗️Comment PRODUCER and I’ll send you access plus a discount to try it.❗️

I recorded this in one take and never touched a timeline. OpusClip’s new AI Producer built the rest.

It’s not an editor, it’s a producer. You describe what you want in plain English and it cuts the filler, adds captions that move with how you talk, pulls in visuals, and hands you a post-ready video. Not templates. It reads your actual footage and reshapes it for that exact video.

Best part? It still sounds like me. It sharpens your voice, it doesn’t replace it. I just give it one last look before it goes out.

Now you know.

#opusclip #aiproducer #aivideo #aitools #contentcreation

text:
Making a video used to take a week. Now it takes a sentence.

I typed one line and HeyGen’s new Video Agent built all of it, the presenter, the animations, the captions, the music. Not templates, it builds every piece from scratch for your exact idea. And the presenter is you, your face, your voice.

The editing is handled. The idea is still yours.

Start free, no card. Link’s in my bio. Now you know.

#heygen #videoagent #aivideo #aitools #aicreator

Seedance 2.5 is now built into Lovart, and one photo is all it takes. Drop in a single product shot and build the entire brand campaign, the ads, the product shots, the characters, all consistent, all in one place. Something off? Change that one detail without redoing the whole thing. Comment Lovart and I’ll send you access. Now you know.

text:
❗️Comment CANVAS and I’ll send you the link.❗️

The number one ranked AI video model on the planet now runs inside a full film studio. Most people won’t catch this for weeks.

ByteDance just dropped Seedance 2.5. 4K, 30 second clips, up to 50 reference images. And a tool called Buzzy just put it on one infinite canvas where you can actually build with it.

One idea in. Buzzy writes the script, generates the character, locks the lighting and the camera angles, and lays out a full 9-square storyboard before you render a frame. One click, full multi-shot video, powered by the best model in the world.

The wild part is the consistency. Same character, same face, same world, every single frame. One shot’s lighting off? You change just that shot and everything else stays locked. That’s the thing AI video could never hold, until now.

Short films, music videos, product spots. All of it, from one canvas.

Now you know.

#buzzyai #aitools #aivideo #seedance #aiforcreators

text:
Snoop Dogg turned into Godzilla and rose out of Long Beach. The AI didn’t do that. A real director did.
Dreamina AI

Jesse Wellens built it inside Dreamina AI. Storyboard the still, pin the face and skyline with Omni Reference, let the physics do the rest. Snoop reposted it with a fire emoji and a gas can.

The taste is human. The tool just removed the roadblocks.

He made it on Seedance 2.0. Dreamina Seedance 2.5 just dropped: 30 second scenes in one shot, up to 50 references, edit one part without regenerating.

Build your own. Link is in my bio.
Now you know.

❗️Link’s in bio. ❗️

Seedance 2.0 vs Seedance 2.5. Same prompt. The distance between having an idea and holding a finished cinematic version just collapsed.

Now live in OpenArt. Thirty seconds in one take. 50 reference cap so a character carries an entire story. Edit one detail without redoing the whole thing.

The people who get this right now look like magicians.

text:
Most business owners don’t have a marketing problem - they have an “I hate being on camera” problem.

So I made an AI twin of myself in captions. I type what I want to say, and a version of me that looks and sounds exactly like me delivers it. Nobody can tell.

Your competitors aren’t better - they just show up. This is how you show up without the camera.

Build yours in the Captions app. 

#contentcreationtips #aitools #aiforbusiness #captionsapp #aitwin

text:
Comment “LovArt” and I’ll send the link + the exact prompts behind it all 👇

You can now speak a brand into existence. 🤯

Logo, palette, brand book, even the cinematic ad — this whole identity was just a conversation. It’s called Lovart: a world-class creative team on one canvas.

Drop in your old logo, say “make us feel like a sanctuary,” and it rebuilds everything. Tap any piece — “make it gold” — done, and it stays on-brand.

Creative work like this was always out of reach for small businesses. Not anymore.

text:
❗️Comment FISH and I’ll send you the link.❗️

You can now tell an AI voice to whisper… or get hyped… and it actually does it.

Fish Audio’s new model reads emotion tags right inside your text - drop in (excited) or (whispering) and the voice performs it. It’s the first TTS that stopped sounding like a robot reading a paragraph.

If you build anything with voice - apps, agents, videos - this changes what’s possible.

#aitools #aiapp #aiagents #voice #fishaudio

text:
Comment ARCADS and I’ll DM you the one that actually builds. 👇

One of these AIs gave me homework. The other gave me a finished ad.

Same six words. Two completely different worlds - and most people are still living in the one that just talks back.

The move now isn’t asking AI what to do. It’s watching it do the whole thing while you sit there.

#aitools #aivideo #claude #arcads #mcp

text:
Reposting this because every time I do my DMs blow up with people showing me their results using this setup. That is why I do this.

Four lights. One look. Butterfly key light directly over your camera for even coverage across the face. Reflector under the chin to kill the shadows that age you. Backlight at 45 degrees to separate you from the background. And an RGB light on the backdrop so you can change the mood without changing a single thing about your setup. This is the beauty and makeup lighting setup that makes people ask what camera are you using when it was never the camera. It was always the light.

Tag someone who does beauty content. They need this.

#contentcreator #beautycontent #contentcreationtips #makeuptutorial #beautylight

I put myself in a horror anime - and it hunted me on the late-night train 🚇🩸

One sentence. Claude researched the trending genre, designed my character from one photo, built the monster and the world, and Higgsfield rendered the whole thing - cuts, sound, everything. No timeline. No editing.

Anime pages are one of the biggest niches on social right now, and you can run one without ever showing your face.

text:
Your light is too far away and it is making every blemish on your face stand out.

Move your light a foot to a foot and a half from your face. The closer the source the larger it appears relative to your skin. Larger source wraps around the blemishes instead of casting tiny shadows on them. Those tiny shadows are what make every pore and imperfection pop on camera. Pull the light in close and they disappear. No filter. No makeup. Just physics. And before someone writes me a novel in the comments yes this is for vertical video. Your light is right outside the frame. Wide shot? Different conversation. But for talking head content this one move does more for your skin than any app ever will.

Have you tried pulling your light closer?
#contentcreator #contentcreationtips #beautytip #cinematiclighting #cinematicvideo

text:
Your skin tone looks different in every single video you post and your audience notices even if you do not.

Auto white balance is your camera guessing what color everything should be. And it guesses differently every time you hit record. That is why you look warm in one video and cold in the next. Your audience cannot build trust with someone who looks like a different person every post. Locking your white balance is not a production flex. It is a consistency decision that makes your brand look like one person across every piece of content.

Have you ever noticed your skin tone shifting between videos?

#contentcreator #contentcreationtips #productionlife #camerasettings #whitebalance

Stop pointing your light at your face. The center of any light is the harshest part. The edge is where the magic is. One aim adjustment and your whole image changes.

Same light. Same room. Completely different face.

Try this tonight.

topComments.text: I’m a Pinball content creator and I appreciate all the lighting tips.  :)

text:
Which one is your go to?

Your shutter speed is deciding how your video feels before you even start talking.

Slow shutter speed adds motion blur. Your movements feel smooth and cinematic. Fast shutter speed freezes everything. Your movements feel sharp and intense. Most creators leave it on auto and let the camera decide the vibe for them. The rule for natural looking video is double your frame rate. Shooting 30fps? Set it to 1/60. That gives you the motion blur your eye naturally expects. Anything faster looks like a soap opera. Anything slower looks dreamy. Neither is wrong. But you should be choosing it on purpose.
